name: Weekly Inverse-Vol Portfolio with Trend Filter
description: Volatility-scaled portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC with a 200-day SMA trend filter. Inverse-volatility weighting with 21-day realized vol lookback, rebalanced weekly on Mondays. Assets trading below their 200-day SMA are excluded and their allocation moves to cash (not redistributed). 100% invested only when all 4 assets are above trend.
source:
# Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio
# Universe: SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC
# Weighting: Inverse volatility (21-day realized vol)
# Rebalance: Weekly on Monday open
# Allocation: 100% fully invested across all 4 assets

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Rebalance Detection ---
# Fire on Monday (start of each trading week)
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.monday)(index())

# --- Trend Filter ---
# 200-day SMA: only hold asset if close > SMA 200, else move to cash
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
above_trend = is_valid(sma_200) and close > sma_200

# --- Volatility Estimation ---
# 21-day annualized realized volatility (feeds close prices per S47)
vol_21d = volatility(period=21)(close)

# --- Inverse-Volatility Weights ---
# All assets always active (always long all 4)
always_active = True

# inv_vol_weight computes w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j) across active assets
# Weights sum to 1.0 across the 4 assets
base_weights = inv_vol_weight()(active_mask=always_active, volatility=vol_21d)

# Apply trend filter: zero weight if below 200-day SMA → allocation goes to cash
# (not redistributed to other assets)
trend_mask = 1.0 if above_trend else 0.0
weights = base_weights * trend_mask

# --- Signal: Always Long ---
# Long signal gated by trend: enter on rebalance if above SMA, exit if below
enter_long = is_new_week and above_trend
exit_long = is_new_week and not above_trend
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# --- Execution ---
# 1. Zone: always long, no short leg
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# 2. Sizing: inv-vol weights × 100 = percent of equity, locked between rebalances
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
